transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Cardholder Services. My name is Taylor. Who do I have the pleasure of speaking with today?
Customer: Hi Taylor, my name is Felix Arango.
Agent: Hello, Mr. Arango. To get started, could you please verify your billing zip code and the last four digits of your card?
Customer: Sure, the zip code is 80204 and the last four digits are 3192.
Agent: Thank you for verifying that. How can I help you today?
Customer: There is a charge on my account from Giftwell Express for $64.50 that I really need some help with.
Agent: Do you happen to remember around what date that charge went through?
Customer: Yes, that was on September 10th.
Agent: I see that transaction right here for $64.50 on September 10th. Could you tell me a little bit about what happened with this order?
Customer: I ordered a present for my nephew's birthday. The main reason I used them was because I paid for guaranteed delivery to make sure it was on his doorstep in time for his birthday.
Agent: What date did they guarantee it would arrive?
Customer: They promised it would be there by September 15th for his party.
Agent: And did the item end up arriving?
Customer: It did arrive, but it showed up an entire week after the promised date. The party was already over, so it completely ruined the point of ordering it.
Agent: Have you reached out directly to Giftwell Express about the late delivery?
Customer: I sent them an email letting them know the package was a week late, but they just said shipping delays sometimes happen and refused to do anything for me.
Agent: I understand. So to make sure I have all the facts down, you paid Giftwell Express $64.50 on September 10th with guaranteed delivery by September 15th, but the package arrived a week late and the seller declined to help.
Customer: Yes, that is exactly what happened.
